mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 30% of instances where RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% month-over-month, it signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as related industries and consumer confidence are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST declines by more than 10% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2%, it signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows and inflation erodes purchasing power.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 consecutive quarters and CPIAUCSL > 2%
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 is negative for two consecutive quarters and CPIAUCSL is above 2%.
